title: Simplistic Cheese
description: This mod is a relatively  simple mod, focused on mainly cheese but also including certain cheesy foods.
body: You have a curdling barrel, which is from where this whole mod developes. Images clearly point how it works. You put in a milk bucket, and it gives you 3 chunks of cheese. With 6 of them, you can craft a wheel of cheese to store it better. Using the jug item added by this, you can fill a jug to 1/3 with 1 chunk of cheese, 2/3 with 2 chunks of cheese, and 3/3 with 3+ chunks of cheese. You can craft 4 cheese slices using one chunk of cheese, and you can use one slice to craft a cheeseburger. You can use the melted from filling the jug to make quesadillas, or pepperoni pizza, having to have it at least 2/3 filled. You can also craft cheese armor.
